# Independent audit: all-dimensional equal-volume midpoint window

Source: `candidate 8407bedf6b42ff39`.
Sections1–5 pass. The exact checker also passes5,000 checks. The theorem
concerns three positive fibers and the explicit condition m/a<=11/8;
it does not establish the unrestricted all-dimensional conjecture.

The complementary truncated endpoint bodies have positive volumes when
the paired captured mass P is below a. Their midpoint lies in the
opposite centroid halfspace of the actual M=(A+B)/2. The root-sum
minimum on a fixed-sum interval is attained at an endpoint by concavity,
giving the stated residual estimate. Its bracket has no hidden negative
root base: Gamma<=1/2 and r>=1 ensure2[(1-Gamma)r]^(1/d)-1>=0.

On the stated window, (1-Gamma)r<7/8. Thus the comparison
2x-1<=x^2 can be raised to the integer power d without reversing or
changing a sign. The difference from Gamma(2-r) is concave in r, so
its minimum is at an endpoint. The source verifies that the endpoint
11/8 is the smaller one. Direct calculation at Gamma=4/11 gives
64delta=5/11=55/121; at Gamma=1/2 it gives55/4. The source's uniform
delta>=55/7744 is therefore correct. The elementary exponential bound
is also correctly strict: after the1/24 term the ratios are at most1/5,
and smaller later, giving e<8/3+5/96=87/32<11/4.

The raw bound c_d a uses M's own centroid cap, not K's centroid bound
at the wrong point. Purely integer halfspaces contain the whole middle
and an endpoint, so their boundary-fiber mass is retained. The two
chosen centers are both actual points of K. Comparing c_d a with
Gamma k and dividing by the ORIGINAL k+2a gives exactly
eta_d=Gamma c_d/(c_d+2Gamma)>Gamma/2. The threshold rule selects one
point deterministically, and the lifted hull has precisely the three
claimed integer fibers.

The directional Holder and section-addition formulas are valid for
d>=2. The d=1 theorem itself uses only the residual argument and is
covered separately by that proof. To make the clipped-height step
explicit, Holder implies
(R+1)^d/(R^(d/(d-1))+1)^(d-1)<=2, so W_d(R)<=2/(d+1)^d<=1.
A fully captured endpoint therefore does dominate the displayed width
bound. If both cap-height ratios are below1, replacing a negative one
by zero only increases their width-weighted sum and permits Holder.

The box calibration is exact:97/72 is the arithmetic mean of9/4
and4/9. In dimension3 the residual factor is348133/331776>1,
and the required paired lower payment exceeds1/32 by575/12288.
For every higher dimension the same r is realized, Gamma decreases,
and the source's strict rational comparison still gives the failure
of coverage by those estimates. The family is explicitly shown to
satisfy OC using the central middle fiber. Thus no failure of an
estimate is misreported as a counterexample to the conjecture or to
the actual centroid choice.

Result: PASS for the stated theorem and the stated insufficiency
certificate. No missing dimension restriction or source switch was found.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
